instruction: A rearing horse frozen mid-leap on a small oval base, its mane and tail streaming back in sculpted ribbons. The entire body is cast in warm brushed brass with fine directional grain that catches soft highlights along the flanks and neck. Subtle darker patina settles into the hooves and muscle grooves, giving weighty realism to the metal form.
